body:
Phase 3 (T-161). Design: "Settling up" in the spec.

BalancesPage gains "Settle up" below the balances: one row per transfer,
"Bob → Alice 12.50", using the existing participant labels (former members
included). "All settled" when there are expenses but no transfers. Hidden on a
solo list.

Record on a row only when it can succeed: list open, both parties current
members, neither has voted to close. It opens the ordinary expense form
pre-filled — title "Settlement" (localized, plain editable text), total,
sole payer, sole beneficiary, today's date. Nothing else changes: the saved
row is an ordinary expense.

Five strings in all nine catalogs. Tests: rows and their order, the button's
four conditions, the pre-filled form, the empty state, the solo case.
title: expenses: web — settle-up section and record
